name: Padini Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026 年 Padini Holdings Berhad 的公告主要涉及股息派发、股东大会及股份回购授权等公司治理事项，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或新合约。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比下降 6.7%，净利润为负；全年营收 18.75 亿 MYR，净利润 1.13 亿 MYR。
overview_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue fell 6.7% year-on-year and net profit was negative; full-year revenue was MYR 1.875 billion with net profit of MYR 112.6 million.
